sampling: Capture the union of two independently seeded uniform row subsets in the same BF16 teacher replay; evaluate each subset separately using its own N/n factor. The old rows exactly preserve the original module-order/call-index seed rule. Singleton/small calls may have identical subsets and are reported.
probe_scope: The original four directions plus four independent four-direction batches, all unit-norm Rademacher vectors over first10 x motor6. New probes do not cover all sixty dimensions.
trajectory: Same eight original BF16 teacher contexts and original sampler seeds; ten video and ten action denoising steps; actual student actions reused from completed source job.
claim_scope: Paired calibration mechanism diagnosis only; no refitting, method selection on test, closed-loop success, other-baseline result or native-kernel latency claim.
decision: Compare actual action projections to the same-direction proxy; isolate probe dependence from row dependence with the frozen-bank factorial, then recommend a bounded codebook objective change based on the observed mismatch.
